mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: To provide transformative theological and music education that equips men and women for faithful, effective ministry and worship leadership in the church and the world.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: To be a premier center of academic excellence and spiritual formation that produces servant-leaders who glorify God through their lives, scholarship, and ministry.

values.title: Biblical Fidelity
values.desc: All learning and practice is anchored in the authority, inerrancy, and sufficiency of Holy Scripture.

values.title: Academic Excellence
values.desc: We hold our curriculum to high standards of theological scholarship and critical inquiry.

values.title: Spiritual Formation
values.desc: Holistic transformation takes place within a praying, worshipping, and supportive community.

values.title: Servant Leadership
values.desc: Education is geared towards humble service to the Church, society, and the Great Commission.

statementOfFaith.intro: Glory Education Center holds firmly to the historic Christian faith expressed in the Holy Scriptures and classic evangelical creeds.

beliefs.content: We believe the Bible (66 books of the Old and New Testaments) to be the inspired, infallible, and authoritative Word of God, fully sufficient for faith and life.
We believe in one God, eternally existing in three co-equal persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, who created and sovereignly rules all things.
We believe in the deity of Jesus Christ, His virgin birth, sinless life, substitutionary atonement on the cross, bodily resurrection, ascension to heaven, and personal return in power and glory.
We believe salvation is entirely by grace alone through faith alone in Jesus Christ, apart from human works, granting eternal life to all who repent and believe.
We believe the Holy Spirit indwells, convicts, regenerates, empowers, and gifts believers for holy living and effective witness in the church and world.
We believe the Universal Church is the body of Christ called to worship God, build up believers, and proclaim the gospel to all nations.

churchProfile.heading: Ecclesial Standing & Affiliation
churchProfile.overview: Glory Education Center operates as an inter-denominational evangelical institution in full fellowship with Bible-believing local churches, Christian networks, and theological accreditation bodies across South Asia.

pillars.title: Inter-Denominational Fellowship
pillars.desc: Welcoming students from diverse orthodox Christian backgrounds, fostering unity in essential truths while respecting diverse ministry contexts.

pillars.title: Church-Centered Ministry
pillars.desc: Every student actively serves in local church assemblies, ensuring academic study remains connected to pastoral practice.

pillars.title: Accreditation & Quality Assurance
pillars.desc: Accredited by recognized theological bodies committed to high academic standards and moral integrity.

history.heading: Our History
history.body: Glory Education Center was established in 2005 by a group of visionary educators and ministry leaders who recognized the need for academically rigorous, spiritually vibrant theological training.

timeline.event: Glory Education Center founded with the first cohort of 20 students in the Bachelor of Theology program.
Launched the Diploma in Music program, expanding GEC's ministry formation offerings.
Received formal accreditation from the Board of Theological Education, affirming academic standards.
Introduced the Master of Divinity (M.Dv) program, welcoming post-graduate students.
Launched the Master of Theology (M.Th) program for advanced research and specialization.
Celebrated 500+ alumni serving across India and internationally in ministry and education.
Marking 20 years of transforming lives through Word and worship.

members.name: Dr. Henry
members.title: Director & Principal
members.bio: Dr. Henry is a writer, musician, pastor, missionary, and educator. As the Director and Principal of Glory Education Centre (GEC), he provides visionary leadership in academic excellence, Christian education, ministry, and community service.

members.name: H. Lunjohnson Misao
members.title: Academic Dean
members.bio: H. Lunjohnson Misao serves as the Academic Dean of Glory Education Centre. He oversees academic planning, curriculum development, and faculty coordination while mentoring students through theological education and Christian ministry.

members.name: Lhiwetshou Tsuhah
members.title: Teaching Faculty & Students Dean
members.bio: Lhiwetshou Tsuhah serves as the Students Dean and teaching faculty member at GEC. With a background in pastoral counselling and missionary service, he is dedicated to student welfare, spiritual formation, and leadership development.
